item.description:
• Projects Console 1.1.1
  • Check for Updates on the Studio too, the stage written back to Notion, and a drive on the shelf stays listed

• Projects Console 1.1.0
  • One record per project on Cloudflare, the pending queue, and the icon into the film
  • The console knocks on Shotlister's doors, and films live in Documents
  • The switchboard's verbs that were only drawn now work
  • Nothing flashes when it repaints
  • The list folds to its icons, at any window width
  • A long name gives way before the lights and the chip do
  • The lights line up whatever the stage chip says
  • Quieter: one verb a row, no sentences, the Notion row folded into PROJECT
  • The switchboard: light · name · readout · verb
  • WIP: dossier, health and names — parked before mockups
  • A lab build beside the real app, and the last of the doc hub and crew

• A real updater and a version number, the Shotlister way
  • Turning one system off, and removing only what it made
  • The doc hub goes, the portal gets his name, RHOJONES is left out of it
  • The README describes the screen that is actually there
  • Say when the drive index has never heard of a folder
  • Renaming a project, in two names rather than one
  • Every system a project can use, on and off alike
  • A film says which project it belongs to, and the console can now read it
  • An agent asking for Reminders gets a dialog instead of a silent refusal
  • A second launch hands off to the copy that is already running
  • Stop asking the keychain for permission twice a minute
  • Make the banner look like a notification, and land somewhere real
  • The Mac says it out loud when an agent acts
  • Find a project whose folder is named nothing like it
  • Stop the login warning outliving the login
  • Keep serving the phone whether or not the window is open
  • Say each thing once
  • Cards in the bell popover say why, not just what
  • Stop agents updating the Claude CLI, and record the next logout properly
  • Saying no sticks
  • Cards say what they did, and where to look
  • A scheduled sweep that found nothing leaves no record
  • Surface an expired Claude login from hand-built agents too
  • Native agents: never file the same held card twice
  • Name the update artifact download
  • Fix the one-click updater destroying the app it installs
  • Add hand-built agents: a second species the app hosts but doesn't configure
  • Agent reliability pass: guards, preflight checks, and Claude-login detection
  • Sign the app with a stable identity so macOS stops re-asking for drive access
  • Agent runs stop faking completion and re-scanning stale backlog
  • Retire the dev/bureau build split — one app, one state dir
  • Fix capability-gap asks naming Gmail when they mean Spark
  • Fix Rebuild.app: re-exec natively, this Mac launches Finder apps under Rosetta
  • Fix Cmd+Q: every tap was quitting, hold detection never worked
  • Add a quit-request trigger file for headless verification
  • Fix Quit: menu bar Quit didn't work, add Cmd+Q tap-vs-hold
  • Fix satellite connection: wrong port + a masked error
  • Merge branch 'r111-transport-split'
  • Fix New Project's crew-linking: engine.fetch_crew/attach_crew_to_project didn't exist
  • R111-R113: Studio/satellite transport split, drive-indexing split, one-click updater
  • Agents remember their own recent decisions in the planning prompt
  • Fix dangling state-dir symlink, add menubar agents submenu, update rituals for new Drive layout
  • Agent list: animate the icon-mode collapse/expand instead of an instant jump
  • Agent list: dragging the divider to its floor snaps into icon-only collapse
  • Agents tab: real drag-resize for left agent panel, move collapse into list box
  • Fix held cards collapsing to blank slivers inline in chat, bubble composer sizing, move collapse toggle
  • Agents tab: shift+enter composer, stop chat mid-thinking, fix left-panel blanking, manual collapse
  • Agent Inbox bubble: fix agent-picker positioning, shrink thread title, add hover polish
  • Agents tab: responsive left panel, button schema match, settings width fix
  • Home page redesign, Agent Inbox bubble, instant chat threads, design cleanup
  • Land the rest of the Custom Agents platform: native tool access, real event detection, contacts read/write, and a premium chat UI
  • Fix: agent guessed the wrong string for a Mail.app account name, every time
  • Trigger source picker expands mail-automation connections into real accounts
  • Event trigger's source field is a real dropdown of granted connections
  • Capability synthesis can now invent a whole new connection, not just a tool
  • Native-read MCP bridge: agents can genuinely call Contacts/Files during planning
  • Fix settings-rail scroll: a class-name collision with the host's own CSS
  • Capability-gap synthesis: agents can build what they're missing, not just refuse
  • QC + QOL hardening pass on the Agents platform
  • Build the Agents platform (studio) — fresh Notion-custom-agents clone
  • Gut the agent system to the studs (fresh-start baseline)
